texts: The crow comes when the grain is spread, and flies when the field is bare; the true friend sits beside the spinning wheel in your poverty.
doha pls: a fair-weather friend is like a crow, he shows up for the crumbs, but a true one sits at your spinning wheel when you're poor
Please write a doha that says the false friend is like the crow that gathers when there are crumbs and caws loudly, but the true friend stays beside you even when you spin for your daily bread.
crow, spinning wheel, false friend
My old buddy used to visit daily when I was rich, but when I had to sit at my mother's spinning wheel to earn, he vanished like a crow after the crumbs; write a doha.
Write a doha that says the true friend is like a shadow that does not leave you in sorrow, whereas the priest may recite blessings and depart; look for the friend who walks beside you in the dark.
doha pls: a true friend is like your shadow, he follows even in tough times, not like those who bless you and bail
The priest at our wedding said we would be friends for life, but it was the shadow of my old classmate who stood beside me when my wife left me; write a doha.
shadow, priest, true friend
A friend is a shadow that stays beside you in bright hours and in dark; the priest's words fade, the shadow does not.
I met my best pal at the market where we both sold vegetables, and he shared his last coin with me when I had none; write a doha.
market, true friend
In the market of the world a thousand faces smile, but only one hand gives in the hour of need.
doha pls: market pals come and go but a true one gives you his last coin
Please craft a couplet that says that in the noisy market of life there are many who call themselves friends, but only the true one sits beside you, sharing his bread when your pockets are empty.
net, false friend
doha pls: a flatterer lays a net of nice words, a real friend tells you straight
The flatterer weaves a net of honey words, and the true friend cuts you free with plain speech.
My colleague kept praising everything I did, all the while spreading a net of rumours behind me; it was the blunt one who warned me, and I want a doha about this.

Write a doha that says the false friend spreads a net of sweet words, catching the trusting with praise, while the true friend risks your anger to tell you the truth, and so the wise know who to hold dear.
doha pls: a blunt friend is like a thorn, it hurts but it saves you from worse
The thorn that pricks you in the open is a better friend than the flower that hides a thorn; value the honest critic.
thorn, honest friend
Compose a doha that says the honest friend who points out your faults is like a thorn that pricks you only to keep you from falling in a pit, and the flatterer, though sweet, leads you to ruin.
My friend told me harshly that my business plan was foolish, and it pricked like a thorn, but he saved me from bankruptcy; write a doha.
lute, steady friend
doha pls: a one-string lute and a true friend both stay in tune even when the world is out of it

Make me a doha saying that a true friend is like a one-string lute whose single note never changes, comforting you in sorrow and rejoicing in your joy, and the wise treasure such a companion above all riches.
The one-string lute sings the same note in joy and in woe, and so does the true friend.
My friend played his one-string lute outside the hospital window for a week when I was ill, and that's the kind of friendship I'd like a doha on.
doha pls: a real friend is the one who shows up when you need him
A friend in need is a friend indeed; in joy the many gather, in sorrow only one.
friend in need
I want a doha that says a friend is proven not at the party but in the hospital room, at the hour of loss, when most turn away and only a loyal one stays; remember that one.
When my father died, three people from my entire circle came to the funeral and stayed to help; write a doha for those three.
Many smile in the season of plenty; one stays in the season of want.

Please write a doha that says false friends flock around a man in good days and scatter in bad ones, while a true friend increases his care when trouble comes, and such a friend is rarer than any treasure.
doha pls: fair-weather pals disappear when it rains
When I lost my job, the buddies who used to drink with me stopped calling, but my quiet classmate brought food every day; write a doha about the difference.
loyal friend

Compose a doha that says a flatterer calls you wise when you are wealthy, and says nothing when you are poor, and so the wise should learn to value the friend who tells the truth when it is unwelcome.
Sweet is the praise of the false friend while fortune smiles, but silent are his lips when it frowns.
doha idea: flatterers are sweet in good times and gone in bad
flattering pal
My uncle was surrounded by yes-men when he was a minister, and not one visited after his retirement; write a doha about those friends of convenience.
A friend is a seed planted in the heart, and a lion in the hour of danger.
seed, lion, friend
doha pls: a seed grows because the lion of a friend guards the field
My childhood friend, brave as a lion, planted a seed of trust in me when we were boys and guarded it fiercely through the years; write a doha about him.
Can you make a doha that says true friendship is like a seed that is sown in the time of ease, and it grows into a lion's strength to protect you in the hour of need.
lotus, loyal friend
doha pls: a real friend is like a lotus, he stays pure even when things get muddy
The lotus keeps its beauty in muddy water and the friend keeps his love in muddy fortunes.
My friend stayed loyal and kind even when my name was dragged through the mud, like a lotus that stays unsoiled; write a doha about him.

Compose a doha that says the true friend is like the lotus that blooms in muddy water without being stained, remaining loyal and bright even when our fortunes are dirty, and he deserves all our respect.
My friend was the only person who told me I was drinking too much, and I hated him for a month, then thanked him for years; write a doha.
doha pls: a real friend tells you the truth even when it hurts
The friend who flatters is a pleasant poison, and the one who warns is a bitter cure; choose the cure.
honest advice
I want a doha that says it is easy to find companions who tell you pleasant things, and hard to find the ones who tell hard truths, but the latter are the real friend and you should hold them close.
jaggery, false friend
Please write a doha that says the false friend is like jaggery, sweet when you taste him in good fortune, but in bad times the sweetness disappears and you are left with nothing but a sticky memory.
doha pls: a sugar-sweet friend like jaggery in good days is bitter in the bad
My friend was as sweet as jaggery when I won the lottery, and sour as can be when I asked him for a loan after; write a doha.
Sweet as jaggery are the words of the false friend in your prosperity; bitter are his words in your need.
My childhood friend stood by me like a tree through every storm, and when he died there was nothing left but ash and memories; write a doha.
Pen a doha that says the true friend is like a tree that gives shade to the weary without being asked, and even if burnt, he gives warmth, and leaves only ash for the earth, with no complaint.
The tree gives shade, and when it burns, it gives warmth; what remains is ash, humble and unclaimed.
tree, ash, devoted friend
doha pls: a tree gives shade to everyone, but a real friend gives warmth even when he's turned to ash
Share not your heart with one whose heart you have not tried; trust is earned with time.
doha pls: don't tell your secrets to just anyone, even a friend
trust in friendship
I trusted a pal with my secrets and he spread them around the whole town; I'd love a doha to remember not to trust too soon.
I want a doha that says before you open your heart to a friend, test him in hard times, because many are friends in name but not in action, and a secret shared too soon becomes a weapon.
My roommate called me his brother and then took my money and left town; write a doha.
Many call themselves companions and few deserve the name; let your heart be careful.
beware false companions
doha plz: be careful who you call a best friend
Please write a doha that says the world has more false friends than true ones, and we must learn to tell the two apart not by their words in good times, but by their actions in bad times.
The moneylender counts his friend by the coin and the weaver by the yarn; a true friend asks neither.
doha pls: a moneylender friend is a friend of your money and a weaver friend is a friend of your time, find the one who's yours
moneylender, loom, friend
Compose a doha that says a friendship that is measured in money like a moneylender's ledger will end when the money ends, whereas the friendship woven patiently like a weaver's loom lasts a lifetime.
The moneylender was kind to me while I owed him, and the weaver at the loom beside me shared his lunch with me when I had nothing; the second was the real friend. Write a doha.
My friend and I got through the worst years together, and the palanquin of his friendship carried me across the ocean of my troubles; write a doha.
Over the ocean of woe the true friend carries you in a palanquin of love.
ocean, palanquin, friend
I want a doha saying that a true friend carries you over the ocean of life's troubles, like bearers carrying a palanquin, and a false one watches from the shore and calls himself a wellwisher.
doha pls: a real friend carries you through the ocean of trouble like a palanquin
net, true vs false friend
doha pls: a friend who casts a net of kindness for you vs a friend who sets a net to catch you, big difference
The net of the false friend closes upon your trust; the net of the true friend holds you when you fall.
Compose a doha that says there are friends who cast a net to catch you and friends who hold a net to save you, and in the hour of danger you will learn which of them you have.
I fell off a roof, and my best pal had stretched a blanket under me like a net, while my other friend only laughed; write a doha.
Write a doha that says the true friend is like milk that gives itself away when mixed with water and like a diamond that does not break under pressure, and such a companion is the greatest gift.
My best friend poured his entire savings into my business like milk into water, and when it failed he stood by me like a diamond; write a doha.
milk, diamond, friend
A friend is milk that mixes with water and gives itself away; he is a diamond that stays unbroken in the heat of trouble.
doha pls: a true friend is like milk with water, he gives himself fully, and like a diamond, he stays strong
At the open door of wealth many friends enter; at the closed door of want none knock.
I'd like a doha that says a friend who comes to your door in times of success but not in times of difficulty is a visitor and not a friend, and the wise understand the difference only after the test.
door, fair-weather friend
The pal who always knocked at my door when I was rich never came back when I went bankrupt, and it taught me who he was; write a doha.
doha pls: a friend who only shows up at your door when you're rich is no friend
A poor beggar who slept on the road near us gave his only cloth sheet to my freezing brother; that is the kind of friend I want to read about in a doha.
The beggar who spreads his cloth sheet over a sleeping friend has given more than a king who gives riches.
Please write a doha that says the true friend gives what he has, even a worn cloth sheet, and shares what little he owns, like a beggar giving his last crumb; he is dearer than a hundred rich ones.
doha pls: a real friend covers you with his cloth sheet in the cold, even if he is a beggar
cloth sheet, beggar friend
My friend was a tree that let me grow freely, while another friend was a cage who kept me close for his own comfort; write a doha.
doha pls: a true friend is a tree for your freedom, a false friend is a cage
The tree gives shelter to the bird, and the cage gives walls; a true friend is the tree, a false one the cage.
tree, cage, true friend
Write a doha that says a friend who loves you gives you the freedom of the open branches like a tree, whereas a false friend who loves only himself traps you in a cage of flattery and dependence.
salt, physician, honest friend
A friend who speaks like salt stings the wound but saves the limb; a physician in disguise is he.
The doctor was a physician friend who told me the salty truth about my health when no one else dared; write a doha.

Give me a doha that says a true friend is like a physician who administers the salt of honest words, painful at first but healing, and a flatterer is a poor doctor who gives you sweets while the disease spreads.
doha pls: the physician of the soul is a good friend, he tells you salt truths
Write a doha that says the true friend does not abandon the boat when it begins to sink, but stays beside you and bails with you, while the false friend is first to leap into the waves.
When my fishing boat capsized, my neighbour rowed out in the storm to save me, though his own boat was old; write a doha.
The friend who jumps into the sinking boat to rescue you, rather than away from it, is the friend a life can be built on.
boat, loyal friend
doha pls: a friend in your boat when it's sinking is a real friend
I want a doha that says that in a lifetime a person may meet thousands but will make only a handful of true friends, and these few are worth more than all the crowd who call themselves so.
rare true friend
I counted my companions at my wedding and in my crisis, and they were not the same people; write a doha.
A hundred will clasp your hand in laughter, but one will hold it in tears; that one is a friend.
doha pls: genuine companions are rare, treasure them
Compose a doha that says the friend who lifts your palanquin of troubles on his own shoulders asks for nothing in return, and such a friend is the closest the Lord comes to a person.
palanquin, loyal friend
At my sister's wedding, my friend helped carry the palanquin all the way up the hill, never once complaining; write a doha about such friends.
The palanquin carries one at a time, but the true friend carries your burden in his heart.
doha pls: a palanquin carries the king but a real friend carries you in rough times
My friend cried with me when I failed, and laughed with me when I recovered, and never once mentioned it afterward; write a doha.

Please craft a couplet that says the friend who shares both your joys and sorrows, without keeping accounts or boasting of his help, is the one whom you must never lose, since such friends are given only once.
To share a smile is easy, to share a tear is hard; he who does both is a friend.
doha pls: a friend shares both your sorrow and your joy
friend in tears and joy
doha pls: a friend who helps you build your house like a potter makes a pot, with patience
The potter builds a house of clay for another, and the true friend builds a home in your heart; both take care.
house, potter, friend

Compose a doha that says the true friend, like a potter shaping clay, patiently builds your house of trust, and it endures through the storm when the houses of flattery built by false friends collapse.
My friend, a potter, helped me build my little house by hand, brick by brick, and never took a penny; write a doha.
The fish does not leave the river when the water is low; the true friend does not leave you in lean times.
Write a doha that says the fish stays in the river even when the water is low and so does the true friend stay beside you in lean times, whereas the false friend leaves at the first sign of drought.
doha pls: a fish in a river sticks with the water, but fair weather friends swim away
fish, river, loyal friend
The fish and river inspired me: my old friend stayed with me like a fish in its river through all seasons while others left; write a doha.
Make me a doha that says the friendship between a beggar and a weaver at his loom is richer than that of two kings, since it is founded on sharing bread and not on weighing status.
beggar, loom, friend
The beggar and the weaver at his loom share a crust and a laugh; no king has such a friend.
A beggar sat by the weaver's loom every evening, and the two became pals, sharing whatever they had; write a doha.
doha pls: a beggar and a weaver at the loom, real friends don't care about status
I want a doha that says the true friend does not wait to be asked, does not boast of his help, and does not remind you of his favours, and he is a rare blessing that should be treasured.
The friend who helps without being asked, and without being noticed, is the truest.
doha pls: friends who help in secret are the best friends
secret helper
Someone left money for my daughter's fees anonymously, and later I found out it was my old friend; write a doha.
lock, priest, trusted friend

Please write a doha that says a friend who knows your lock and keeps it safe, who shares your secrets with no one but the priest of his own conscience, is a treasure beyond price, and deserves loyalty.
I confessed my mistake to my friend rather than the priest, and he never told a soul, and I think he locked it in his heart; write a doha.
doha pls: a true friend keeps your secrets locked, even from the priest
The lock on your secret is opened only by the true friend, and the priest of his heart keeps the silence.
My friend of thirty years is as faithful as a chakor and as steady as a tortoise; write a doha for our anniversary of friendship.
The chakor loves without end, the tortoise walks without haste; the true friend does both.
chakor, tortoise, constant friend
doha pls: a friend loves like the chakor loves its beloved and walks as steady as a tortoise
Write a doha that says the true friend is as faithful as the chakor who gazes on the beloved with undying love and as steady as the tortoise who goes slowly but never turns back.
traveler, companion
Can you make a doha that says the traveler is lucky who finds a friend on the road of life, a friend who shares his water and his silence, and does not leave him when the road turns steep.
doha pls: a traveler's best friend is the one who walks with him on the lonely road
On my long solo trip, I met a stranger who walked with me for days and shared his food, and I think of him as my truest friend; write a doha.
On the long road the traveler knows his friend, who carries half his burden and all his hopes.
I rang my friend's bell in the middle of the night, and he came with his shoes untied; write a doha.
bell, ready friend
The bell rings only when it is struck; the friend answers only when you call, and so you must call.
Write a doha that says a true friend is like a bell that answers at once when struck, and one need not plead for help, because he is always listening for the call of his friend.
doha pls: a friend is like a bell, ring him in need and he answers
Compose a doha that says the friendship of the self-seeking is like the dew, pretty and cool in the morning but vanishing in the heat of the day, and the wise do not build their lives on it.
Like dew upon the grass is the smile of the false friend, bright at dawn and gone at the first heat.
doha pls: false friends are like dew, they shine in the morning and are gone by noon
dew, fleeting friend
My friend's loyalty evaporated like dew when I lost my fortune; write a doha.
The furnace tests the metal, and trouble tests the friend; what survives is the true.
When my business burned like a furnace, only two friends stayed to help me carry the heat; write a doha.
furnace, tested friend
Pen a doha that says the furnace burns away the impure and leaves the real, and in the same way the heat of hardship separates the fair-weather friend from the true one, who remains.
doha pls: a furnace shows what's real and so does a hard time with a friend
doha pls: a beggar can be a better friend than a rich man
A beggar I once fed on the roadside came back years later and saved my life; I learned friends can come from anywhere. Write a doha.
The beggar returns kindness with a loyal heart; the rich man forgets favours in a day.
Write a doha that says that the friendship of the poor is often truer than that of the rich, since the beggar remembers the kindness shown to him and the wealthy man forgets all debts.
beggar, unexpected friend
doha pls: a fish shares its pond with everyone, a true friend shares his prayer beads with you
The fish shares its pond with its fellows, and the friend shares his prayer beads and his prayers.
fish, prayer beads, friend
Compose a doha that says a friend who shares his prayer beads with you and prays for you is like a fish that shares its water, selfless and silent, and the Lord will bless such a friendship.
My friend lent me his prayer beads during my illness and prayed for me all night; it reminded me of schooling fish moving together. Write a doha.
I want a doha that says the true friend is a lion in the hour of danger, protecting you from those who would harm you, whereas the false friend vanishes like a mouse when the roar of trouble begins.
When the bully threatened me, my friend stood in front of me like a lion; write a doha.
doha pls: a lion-hearted friend vs a coward friend, which is yours?
The lion stands before the danger, and so does the friend; the others vanish like smoke.
lion, brave friend
Fortune fills the room with friends, misfortune empties it; count them then.
After my accident, I learned exactly who my pals were, and the number was small but the quality was precious; write a doha.
companions tested and proven
I want a doha that says good times are a false teacher of loyalty, for all appear loyal, and only bad times reveal which of them were ever real, so the wise value the test of adversity.
doha pls: you only know your real companions when you're down
On the scales of misfortune the false friend weighs nothing, and the true one is a lotus, unsullied.
Compose a doha that says the scales of hardship weigh friendships truly, and the false friend lifts like chaff while the true friend, like a lotus in the mud, remains steady and pure.
I weighed my friendships on the scales of my hardship, and a lotus of a friend kept blooming for me; write a doha.
scales, lotus, tested friend
doha pls: weigh your friends on the scales of adversity, the lotus ones stay clean
The cuckoo sings only in spring; the pearl waits patiently in the dark; the friend is the pearl, not the cuckoo.

Write a doha that says the fair-weather friend is like the cuckoo that sings only in the season of plenty, and the true friend is like a pearl that is rare, hidden and priceless, found only by those who search.
The cuckoo sang sweet songs on my branch when the spring was here, and flew away to another branch when my branches were bare, like my wealthy friends; I'd like a doha.
cuckoo, pearl, friend
doha pls: a fair-weather friend is a cuckoo, a true friend is a pearl
The rainbird waits for the rain, and the true friend waits for his friend to return from wandering.
I'd like a doha that says the true friend is patient like the rainbird that waits for the drops of the monsoon, and he will wait for years for his friend to return, without bitterness.
doha pls: a friend who waits for you like a rainbird waits for rain
rainbird, patient friend
My friend waited for years for me to forgive him, like a rainbird patient for rain, and I finally did; write a doha.
The date palm stands tall at the door, but gives only its shade to the near; so a friend is measured not by height but by closeness.
doha pls: a friend should be like the date palm by your door, tall and sheltering, not just tall
At the door of my old friend's cottage there was a tall date palm that shaded me many afternoons; he was just like that, tall but giving; write a doha.
door, date palm, friend
Write a doha that says a friend who stands tall like a date palm beside your door but gives neither shade nor fruit is of no use, while the humble friend who gives freely is a true friend.
My neighbour, who claimed to be my friend, planted false stories about me at work, and I never suspected; write a doha.
friend and foe
doha pls: some friends are enemies in disguise
Please write a doha that says an open enemy can be fought and avoided, but an enemy who wears the mask of a friend is far more dangerous, and so the wise watch deeds and not words.
The smiling enemy is worse than the open one; guard against the friend who harms with kindness.
Give me a doha that says the friend who is like the chakor, loving with undying devotion, and who goes with you even to the mosque to pray for your recovery, is a gift of the Lord.
The chakor looks to its beloved with unwavering eyes, and the friend looks to you as he kneels at the mosque.
doha pls: a friend who stays loyal like the chakor and even sits with you at the mosque
My Hindu friend sat with me through the night at the mosque when my father was dying, as devoted as a chakor to its beloved; write a doha.
chakor, mosque, devoted friend
doha pls: a friend who forgives is a gem
forgiving friend
To forgive a friend is to hold the friendship higher than the hurt.
My best friend and I didn't speak for two years after our fight, until he said sorry first; write a doha.
I want a doha that says friends will often hurt each other without meaning to, and the true friend is the one who forgives, who goes first to mend, and who keeps the bond above his pride.
doha pls: a true friend lives in your heart, not in a palace
The prince was lonely in his palace but the poor shepherd had a friend; write a doha about that difference.
Compose a doha that says wealth can fill a palace with servants and visitors, but cannot fill it with a single true friend, who is found only when one is humble enough to be a friend in return.
palace, friend, poor
Not in the palace but in the cottage the true friend is found, for love has no need of walls.
